environment.description: Production deployment on EKS with the Terraform provider backend connecting to Aurora PostgreSQL. The database user 'tf_provider_svc' has been granted full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on the tf_resources table. The service is exposed via internal NLB with mTLS between tenants and the provider. Each tenant authenticates with a valid client certificate, and X-Tenant-ID is set by the mTLS termination proxy. No row-level security policies are active on the database.

config.db_grants: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON tf_resources TO tf_provider_svc
